<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child*)>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % pe " <!ELEMENT extra (#PCDATA)> ">
  %pe;
  <!ENTITY ent "Resolved Entity Text">
  <?custom-pi target="data" processing="true"?>
]>
<root xmlns="http://example.com/ns" xmlns:sub="http://example.com/sub" sub:attr="value">
  <!-- This is a top-level documentation comment covering the entity expansion zone -->
  <sub:child>
    <![CDATA[ CDATA containing markup-like strings <test>&ent;</test> ]>
  </sub:child>
  <child>&ent;</child>
</root>
```

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (item*)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % inner "sub-element">
  <!ENTITY base "Base Entity">
  <?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
]>
<catalog xmlns="http://schemas.example.org/catalog" xmlns:xi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XInclude">
  <!-- Comment 1: Description of catalog schema compliance -->
  <item>
    <?target-instruction data="initialize"?>
    <![CDATA[
      Some raw CDATA payload with entities &base; embedded.
    ]]>
  </item>
  <item>&base;</item>
</catalog>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE document [
  <!ELEMENT document (section*)>
  <!ELEMENT section (paragraph*)>
  <!ELEMENT paragraph (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ent1 "First Entity">
  <!ENTITY ent2 "&ent1; and Second Entity">
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY logo SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
  <?xml-log level="debug" mode="verbose"?>
]>
<document xmlns="http://xml.org/document/ns" xmlns:meta="http://xml.org/document/meta">
  <!-- Complex structural comment block before meta section -->
  <meta:section>
    <?meta-control action="refresh"?>
    <paragraph>
      <![CDATA[
        Critical data section with unparsed entities like &ent2; and tags <tag>.
      ]]>
    </paragraph>
  </meta:section>
  <section>
    <paragraph>&ent2;</paragraph>
  </section>
</document>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE archive [
  <!ELEMENT archive (record*)>
  <!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY company "Global Corp">
  <!ENTITY copyright "Copyright © 2025 &company;">
  <?archive-meta status="active" version="2.0"?>
]>
<archive xmlns="http://example.org/archive" xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/">
  <!-- Record container with mixed content and namespaces -->
  <record>
    <?dc-instruction creator="Admin"?>
    <![CDATA[
      Archive entry body containing special sequences: <script>alert(1)</script> ©right;
    ]]>
  </record>
  <record>©right;</record>
</archive>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE suite [
  <!ELEMENT suite (test*)>
  <!ELEMENT test (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % ext SYSTEM "external.ent">
  %ext;
  <!ENTITY default-val "Standard Test Configuration">
  <?suite-config cache="false"?>
]>
<suite xmlns="http://w3.org/suite" xmlns:cfg="http://w3.org/suite/config">
  <!-- Detailed processing instructions and namespace attributes validation block -->
  <cfg:test>
    <?cfg-action run="all"?>
    <![CDATA[
      Test vector CDATA zone: verifying parser robustness against nested markup like <item> &default-val; </item>
    ]]>
  </cfg:test>
  <test>&default-val;</test>
</suite>
